branches.conclusion: The Technology Management and Economics doctoral school and its exact PhD award remain verified from the 21 October official syllabus read. Supply and Operations Management is an officially named division participating in that broader doctorate, not a formally named doctoral specialization or hosting department/school under the strict title rule.

The complete current subject-oriented graduate-school directory was read. The plausible Product and Production Development, Machine and Vehicle Systems, Shipping and Marine Technology, Computer Science and Engineering, and Electrical Engineering doctoral-school pages were read. Formal Product/Production specializations are product development, manufacturing processes and production systems; Machine/Vehicle lists AI, vehicle dynamics and traffic safety; Shipping/Marine lists naval architecture, shipping technology, maritime environmental science and energy/environmental systems analysis. Other engineering titles and operational applications alone do not meet the exact Operations/Management Science/Industrial Engineering title rule. The two existing broader doctoral observations remain factual and excluded by their title-scope decisions.

Applied Mathematics and Statistics and Mathematical Statistics pages were read, but the separate Mathematics doctoral-school page timed out 26 October. The central graduate-school list names Mathematics without detailed formal field inventory; a named OR specialization within Mathematics cannot yet be ruled out.
